objective: The owner's request of 2026-11-25 that the thread work through its four top-valued directions in parallel; this is the untaken lead of the fourth, time with nothing supplied (sub-goal B328; assumptions A247 and A228; goals G5 with G18). Births made one at a time need to know which of the knots a knot meets is its parent. The least record found is one of three values on each knot, each new knot writing one step on from its parents' value; that value is written beside the structure by whoever runs the growth. The question: can the structure hold it, that is, is there something a knot has by the growth law itself, in its own places or in how they are shared, that is one step on from what its parents have, so that before and after is carried by distinctions? First step: list what a knot has, under each recorded law, that differs from what its parents have by a fixed step (counts of places, of fresh distinctions, of holders), and test each as the record in the search already written. Stop at one that recovers the parents at a bounded number of steps on every structure reached, or at a reason no count of a knot's own places can. Standard: the claim stated before it is tested; a frozen pre-registration reviewed cold by the advisor; an engine written from the frozen text by a helper who has not seen the prototype; the knot test on every knot made under parity and not-all-equal; every added rule, weighting and hand-built start named as a scaffold and swapped; supplied or made said plainly; nothing called typical, rare or likely without its weighting; no claims about physics, physical time, living things or minds; every new word checked with the advisor.
title: A count of descent held by the structure itself
